title: USC OIS: Curricular Practical Training (curated summary)
text:
USC CPT means Curricular Practical Training: F-1 authorization for degree-related off-campus academic training, paid or unpaid. Under the current OIS guidance, training must satisfy a curriculum requirement shared by domestic and international students in that program. An optional internship or elective alone does not qualify.
USC CPT application: obtain an offer meeting the program's training requirement; arrange required course enrollment and any D-Clearance. Submit the CPT I-20 request through Trojan International with the offer letter and the school-employer cooperative agreement. The OIS page links a separate Viterbi request. An academic advisor or internship coordinator reviews the request, and OIS issues the authorized I-20. Consult the source for the course-registration sequence when D-Clearance is needed.
USC CPT work start: receiving an offer or submitting a request is insufficient. Wait for the CPT-authorized I-20 and its approved employment start date. Confirm individual eligibility with OIS. Accumulating at least 12 months of full-time CPT at a degree level removes OPT eligibility at that level; part-time CPT does not have that effect.
curation_note: Concise paraphrase checked against the linked USC page via web retrieval. Not a complete page snapshot or a substitute for OIS advice.
